component: label-adjacent NEC schematic flowline; interior reach only
source_citation: Stramma and Schott1999, The mean flow field of the tropical Atlantic Ocean, Deep-Sea Research II46,279-303
coordinate_selection: Rounded OSW waypoints follow the westward schematic curve adjacent to the NEC label. Other parallel NEC arrows are excluded. No digitized velocity axis or mean of those arrows is claimed.
layer: Schematic Tropical Surface Water,approximately0-100m; not a fixed-depth velocity core.
time_convention: Source northern spring and northern fall climatological schematics. No observation year, monthly geometry or annual extremes.

gate_convention.reason: Interior mid-basin reach following one explicitly chosen schematic curve; exclude eastern source transitions, western island approaches and boundary-current extensions.

scenario_rule.interpretation: Independent drawing and western-gate choices, not physical uncertainty, seasonal extrema, current width or confidence. Half-degree drawing shifts are specific editorial tests for this coarse schematic; not universal precision.

excluded_features: North Equatorial Countercurrent and Guinea Dome circulation
Atlantic SEC including northern SEC branch
